channel.title: Yu, Jia-Wei · Blog
channel.description: Articles by Yu, Jia-Wei on robotics, networks, and software tools. Subscribe for summaries and follow the links to read the full articles.

item.title: Real-Time Control and Network Architecture for Brushless Servo Motors
item.description: Software and network design tradeoffs for real-time control of multiple servo motors, covering network topology, command and status interfaces, communication latency, and control algorithms. This article is a work in progress.

item.title: Network Security Architecture and End-Devices Topology
item.description: An overview of Access-Aggregation-Core and Leaf-Spine topologies, comparing their approaches to north-south and east-west traffic and discussing redundancy for firewalls and core switches.

item.title: The Ultimate Setup for Mihomo Network Proxies without GUI
item.description: A practical guide to configuring and running Mihomo directly, covering network proxy concepts, configuration, and the reasons for moving from graphical clients to command-line tools.

item.title: I Think Browser Should Serve As a EPUB and PDF Reader
item.description: Introducing pdf.ts and epub.ts, two readers designed for a browser-based workflow, with lightweight interfaces, annotations, and ebook styling, alongside comparisons with existing readers.

item.title: Deep-Debloating Windows 11
item.description: Personal notes on trimming Windows 11, covering preinstalled software, AI components, search indexing, and browser components, along with alternative tools.
